title: « C'est Karim » : five Karims, two of them butchers in Limoges
trap: The caller gives only a first name shared by five contacts, then a town that still leaves two Limoges butchers (Marty and Deschamps): the agent must keep asking instead of picking one.
turns: Ouais, bonjour, c'est Karim. Pour vendredi, vous me mettez deux arrières et dix kilos de bavette.
Karim, le boucher, à Limoges. Vous me connaissez, quand même, depuis le temps.
Schneider. Maison Deschamps, boulevard de la Croix-Rousse. Donc deux arrières et dix kilos de bavette, pour vendredi. C'est noté où, ça ?
Vous me relisez la commande ? … C'est bon, validez.
expected: No order is created and no line is added before the caller says « Schneider, Maison Deschamps » (turn 3).
After turn 1, and again after turn 2, the agent asks one short question (which shop, or the surname) and never guesses between Boucherie-Charcuterie Marty and Maison Deschamps.
Final ERP: one new order for cli_0092, delivery 2026-11-27, with prd_0001 at about 200 kg (180 to 220, two quarters) and prd_0014 at 10 kg.
The agent says the quarters are an estimated weight and that the invoice follows the real weight.
CMD-2026-006254 (cli_0092, confirmed for 25/11) and CMD-2026-006239 (cli_0069, draft for 25/11) are unchanged.
The agent does not bring up Maison Deschamps' overdue invoices and says nothing about the other Karims' accounts.
facts: Contacts named Karim: Karim Schneider (cli_0092 Maison Deschamps, Limoges), Karim Adam (cli_0069 Boucherie-Charcuterie Marty, Limoges), Karim François (cli_0059 Boucherie Ludovic et Fils, Ambazac), Karim Faure (cli_0057 Les Gîtes de Montjovis, Magnac-Laval), Karim Bertin (cli_0014 Marché Plus Feytiat).
cli_0092 and cli_0069 are both active butchers in Limoges, both delivered wed and fri: 11 boulevard de la Croix-Rousse versus 33 rue Jean-Jaurès.
prd_0001 is sold by the kilo, quarter of 90 to 110 kg; Tuesday for Friday respects the 2-day lead time for quarters.
Stock for 2026-11-27: prd_0001 about 4 080 kg once ACH-2026-001465 (due 25/11) is counted, prd_0014 about 568 kg.
cli_0092 is active, not blocked; persona sheet: 2 overdue invoices, 6 834,93 €.

title: Two questions first (his price, stock for Friday), then a small order: Maison Vergnaud
trap: A starred chef asks two pure questions before ordering: nothing may be created while he is only asking, the prices must be his own, and the near-empty stock of carré de veau must be told honestly.
turns: Bonjour, Antoine Vergnaud, Maison Vergnaud. Avant de commander, une question : le filet de bœuf et la longe de cul noir, ils sont à combien pour moi en ce moment ?
Bien. Et le carré de veau, vous en aurez pour vendredi ? Il m'en faudrait six kilos, couleur un.
Je vois. Pas de substitution, vous le savez. Alors pour vendredi, mettez-moi quatre kilos de filet et cinq kilos de longe de cul noir, avec son gras.
Ce sera tout. Vous me rappelez le jour et les prix ?
expected: After turns 1 and 2 there is still no new order for cli_0002 (he only asked questions).
Prices spoken: filet 42,24 € HT le kilo and longe de cul noir 12,20 € HT le kilo. Not 44,00, not 12,80, not 41,88.
Carré de veau: the agent says only about 1,6 kg is available for Friday, so not the 6 kg asked, and gives no arrival date (the ERP has none).
No substitute (quasi, noix) is put on the order; the agent may at most ask whether he wants one.
Final ERP: one new order for cli_0002, delivery 2026-11-27, with prd_0012 4 kg at 42,24 and prd_0030 5 kg at 12,20 carrying the note « avec son gras »; no prd_0022 line.
Today's prepared order CMD-2026-006246 is unchanged.
facts: cli_0002 is active, delivered tue, thu, fri, group restaurants; sole contact Antoine Vergnaud (vouvoie).

clientPrices for cli_0002: prd_0030 12,20 (list 12,80) and prd_0011 30,00. None for prd_0012, so prl_0003 (restaurants, minus 4 % on pad-boeuf) gives 44,00 x 0,96 = 42,24; today's order CMD-2026-006246 (ord_020808) has the filet line at 42,24. 41,88 is the older price on CMD-2026-006155.
prd_0022 (carré de veau): 1,65 kg on hand in one lot (lot_019018, expires 2026-11-29), nothing reserved, and it is in no open purchase order.
Stock for 2026-11-27: prd_0012 about 105 kg counting 30 kg due 25/11 (ACH-2026-001465); prd_0030 about 63 kg counting ACH-2026-001464 (45 kg due 26/11), 18 kg without it.
CRM preference of cli_0002: « Jamais de substitution ».

Samedi dernier, oui, la livraison du vingt-et-un. Tout pareil sauf l'épaule de veau. Et le paleron, vous m'en mettez le double.

trap: She wants an order already confirmed in the ERP moved to a day she is not delivered, then to Saturday: the existing order must be re-dated, never duplicated, and Thursday must be refused.
turns: Oui, Nadine, Au Routier de Limoges. Ma commande de demain, vous me la décalez à jeudi, j'ai une privatisation qui a sauté. Vite, j'ai pas le temps.
Bon, samedi alors, samedi ça me va. Mais c'est la même commande, hein : vous m'en créez pas une deuxième et vous touchez pas aux quantités.
C'est bon, c'est décalé ? Dites-moi juste le jour et je raccroche.
expected: After turn 1 the agent says Thursday is not one of her delivery days (mercredi and samedi) and offers Saturday 28/11; it never confirms Thursday.
Final ERP: CMD-2026-006257 has delivery date 2026-11-28, is not cancelled, and keeps its four lines unchanged (prd_0014 19 kg, prd_0045 14 colis, prd_0030 15,5 kg, prd_0009 19 kg).
cli_0042 has no other order dated 2026-11-25 or later: no duplicate, nothing left on 25/11 or 26/11.
The last answer is one short sentence naming « samedi 28 », without re-reading the whole order.
facts: cli_0042 (Au Routier de Limoges, brasserie, Limoges) is active and delivered wed and sat only; sole contact Nadine Picard (tic « Vite, j'ai pas le temps. »).

CMD-2026-006257 (ord_020819) is confirmed for 2026-11-25, note « Pré-commande, peut encore ajuster ce soir », lines prd_0014 19 kg, prd_0045 14 colis, prd_0030 15,5 kg, prd_0009 19 kg. It is her only open order.

title: Canteen calling the day before, with a purchase-order number: Résidence Les Chênes
trap: A residence kitchen asks for tomorrow, which is her delivery day and in stock, but collectivités order 3 days ahead: the agent must refuse tomorrow, book the next Wednesday and write the purchase-order number on the order.
turns: Bonjour, Sandrine Fournier, Résidence Les Chênes, au Palais-sur-Vienne. Je vous appelle pour la livraison de demain mercredi : quatre-vingts kilos de paleron et vingt cartons de steaks hachés.
Les steaks hachés, c'est le surgelé, les cartons de cinq kilos. Je sais que conformément au contrat c'est trois jours avant, mais on a eu un souci de mail : c'est bien bon pour demain ?
Bien. Alors mercredi prochain, le deux décembre, mêmes quantités. Merci de mentionner le numéro de bon : BC 2026 tiret 0412. Et il me faut ça par écrit.
Vous me relisez la commande, avec le numéro de bon ?
expected: Nothing is created for cli_0089 on 2026-11-25: the agent says collectivités order 3 days ahead and offers Wednesday 2 December.
Final ERP: one new order for cli_0089, delivery 2026-12-02, with prd_0017 80 kg and prd_0055 100 kg (20 cartons of 5 kg).
« Steaks hachés » is the frozen product prd_0055, not prd_0044 or prd_0045, and the quantity is never 20.
The order note contains the purchase-order number « BC 2026-0412 », and the agent says it back in the read-back.
The agent does not promise a written or e-mail confirmation unless it really has a way to send or log one.
The draft CMD-2026-006225 of Résidence Les Pins (cli_0040) is unchanged.
facts: cli_0089 (Résidence Les Chênes, type canteen, group collectivites, Le Palais-sur-Vienne) is active and delivered wed only; contacts Sandrine Fournier, Nicolas Olivier, Michel Carré. It has no open order (last one CMD-2026-005792, delivered 04/11).

House rule (02-journee-type.md, 06-livraisons-zones.md): « Collectivités : commande à J-3 avant 11h, avec numéro de bon ». Over the last 12 months all 491 canteen orders were created exactly 3 days before delivery.
apps/ai/app/tools/desk.py only encodes two lead times (carcasses 2 days, prd_0011 7 days): nothing stops a canteen order for the next day.
prd_0055 is sold by the kilo, carton of 50 x 100 g = 5 kg; collectivités price 7,98 (prl_0004, minus 5 % on 8,40). « Steak haché » is a listed ambiguous alias (prd_0044, prd_0045, prd_0055).

title: « Du veau et de l'agneau, je te fais confiance » : Restaurant Vidal
trap: A chef names two animals with no cut and no quantity and says « je te fais confiance »: the agent must ask, not choose, then map « bourguignon » to fresh paleron and not to the frozen canteen product.
turns: Salut, c'est Serge, du restaurant Vidal. Pour vendredi, tu me mets du veau et de l'agneau, je te fais confiance.
Ben, le veau, de la noix, cinq kilos. Et l'agneau, du gigot : deux gigots.
Ah, et huit kilos de bourguignon. Du frais, hein, pas ton surgelé de cantine.
C'est tout. On travaille ensemble depuis le temps… je te fais confiance.
expected: After turn 1 nothing is created: the agent asks which cuts and how many kilos, and chooses neither a cut nor a quantity.
No carcass product is ever put on the order (prd_0004, prd_0005, prd_0006).
Final ERP: one new order for cli_0063, delivery 2026-11-27, with prd_0020 5 kg, prd_0026 about 5 kg (4,4 to 5,6 for two gigots) and prd_0017 8 kg.
« Bourguignon » is prd_0017 (paleron PAD), not prd_0056.

facts: cli_0063 (Restaurant Vidal, Rochechouart) is active, delivered tue, wed, fri; contacts Serge Robin (tutoie, tic « Je te fais confiance. ») and Yann Ménard.
Glossary, ambiguous aliases: a restaurant saying « du veau » wants PAD pieces, ask which; « agneau » for a restaurant is gigot (prd_0026) or épaule (prd_0028), carcass only for a butcher.
« bœuf bourguignon » is an alias of prd_0017; « bourguignon surgelé » is an alias of prd_0056.

title: Short weight, credit note and « dix pour cent » : Le Relais des Monts
trap: He complains of a missing kilo on a delivered order, asks for a credit note, then for a discount on a new order: the agent must read the real weigh figures, log the complaint, promise no credit note and grant no discount.
turns: Bonjour, Anh Boucher, le Relais des Monts. Dites, sur ma livraison de mardi dernier, j'avais commandé vingt-cinq kilos d'entrecôte et il en manquait un bon kilo. Vous me faites un avoir ?
Bon. Vous le notez, au moins ? Et pour vendredi il me faut quinze kilos de bavette. Avec ce qui s'est passé, vous me faites dix pour cent dessus.
C'est combien au kilo, ramené ? … Bon, allez, mettez-les quand même. Et vous avez des fins de lot, en ce moment ?
expected: The agent finds CMD-2026-006089 (17/11) and gives the real figures: 25 kg ordered, 24 kg weighed, invoiced on 24 kg. No other figure is made up.
It never says a credit note will be made; it says who decides (the accounts department or his salesman) and logs the complaint as a client event on cli_0061 tied to that order.
No discount: the price said and stored for the bavette is 17,80 € HT le kilo, not 16,02.
Final ERP: one new order for cli_0061, delivery 2026-11-27, with prd_0014 15 kg at 17,80.
The agent invents no « fin de lot » or promotion, and does not raise his overdue invoices.
facts: cli_0061 (Le Relais des Monts, brasserie, Limoges) is active, delivered tue and fri; sole contact Anh Boucher (tics « C'est combien au kilo, ramené ? », « Vous avez des fins de lot ? »).
CMD-2026-006089 (ord_020651, delivered Tuesday 2026-11-17, invoiced): prd_0010 ordered 25 kg, prepared 24 kg, from lot_018940; same order, prd_0009 18 ordered, 17,29 prepared.
Invoice FAC-2026-003719 (inv_012112) bills that entrecôte line on 24 kg at 23,64: the missing kilo was not charged.
No price rule covers brasseries on PAD beef and cli_0061 has no negotiated price: prd_0014 is at list 17,80 (as on today's CMD-2026-006222).
House rules: only Jean-Louis and the salesmen grant a discount; a credit note above 150 € HT needs the management.
Persona sheet: 5 overdue invoices, 20 946,66 €, account not blocked. Stock of prd_0014 for 27/11: about 568 kg.

title: Unknown caller with a look-alike name: « Le Petit Rocher » à Couzeix
trap: A restaurant that is not in the ERP has a name one letter away from Le Petit Roger: the agent must not attach the order to a look-alike client, nor invent an account, a price or a delivery promise.
turns: Bonjour, restaurant Le Petit Rocher, à Couzeix. On ouvre la semaine prochaine, on m'a dit que vous faisiez du bœuf limousin. Je voudrais dix kilos d'entrecôte pour vendredi.
Non non, pas Le Petit Roger : Le Petit Rocher, R, O, C, H, E, R, à Couzeix. On n'a jamais commandé chez vous, on n'a pas de compte.
Bon. C'est combien le kilo, l'entrecôte ? Et vous livrez Couzeix quels jours ?
D'accord. Je suis Thibault Lenoir, le zéro six, douze, trente-quatre, cinquante-six, soixante-dix-huit. Vous me faites rappeler par un commercial ?
expected: No order is created at all: nothing on cli_0016 (Le Petit Roger), cli_0055 (Le Petit Rouchaud), cli_0060 (Le Petit Guillot), nor on the Couzeix clients cli_0027 and cli_0036.
The agent says it finds no account under that name and that it cannot take an order without one; it creates no client record.
If it gives a price it is the catalogue price, 24,00 € HT le kilo, presented as the list price; no personal price, no discount.
It may say Couzeix is on the Limoges round (Monday to Saturday) but does not promise a delivery on Friday.
It takes the name and the number, and says a salesman will call back only if it has really recorded the message; otherwise it says plainly what it can do.
facts: No client or prospect is called Le Petit Rocher; the four prospects in the ERP are cli_0009, cli_0010, cli_0015 and cli_0052.
Look-alikes: Le Petit Roger (cli_0016, Isle), Le Petit Rouchaud (cli_0055, Ambazac), Le Petit Guillot (cli_0060, Isle).
Clients in Couzeix: La Boucherie de Couzeix (cli_0027) and Maison Hubert (cli_0036). Couzeix (87270) belongs to the zone Limoges et agglomération, round rte_0001, Monday to Saturday.
prd_0010 (train de côtes / entrecôte) list price 24,00 € HT per kilo; franco at 200 € HT, otherwise 15 € delivery.
Restaurants are followed by Nicolas Bouty (commercial restauration).
The caller's name and phone number are invented for the test and are in no seed file.

title: Côtes maturées 21 jours for this Saturday: Les Saveurs de Bourganeuf
trap: He wants matured ribs four days ahead, against the written one-week rule, and the ageing room covers it. Team decision (lane A + lane D, 01:17, DECISIONS § 2.8): we follow the data, not the document, so the order is ACCEPTED, the rule is said as a habit, never as a refusal or a stock-out, nothing is substituted, and the quantity is exactly 12 kg. Then he books the following Saturday too: two orders, read back, confirmed only after his yes.
turns: Bonjour, Julien Mazaud, Les Saveurs de Bourganeuf. J'ai pas pu appeler hier : il me faut mes côtes de bœuf maturées pour samedi, douze kilos, à peu près comme la semaine dernière. Pas un gramme de moins.

Turn 2: a second order for 2026-12-05 with prd_0011 12 kg, without a duplicate line on the 28/11 order.
Both orders are read back before confirmation, and confirm_order is called only in turn 3, after his « oui, c'est bon ».
Final ERP: cli_0074 has a confirmed order on 2026-11-28 with prd_0011 12 kg and a confirmed order on 2026-12-05 with prd_0011 12 kg, and no prd_0010 line on either.
facts: cli_0074 (Les Saveurs de Bourganeuf, restaurant, Creuse) is active, delivered wed and sat; contacts Julien Mazaud (tic « Pas un gramme de moins. ») and Kenji Schmitt. No open order.
House rule: « Côtes de bœuf maturées 21 jours : réservation une semaine à l'avance »; CRM note of 18/09/2026: « Julien réserve ses côtes maturées le lundi pour le week-end ».

The data contradicts the rule: over the last 12 months all 692 prd_0011 lines were ordered 1 to 3 days ahead, none a week ahead.
Stock of prd_0010 for 28/11: about 294 kg. Restaurant prices (prl_0003): prd_0010 23,04 and prd_0011 30,24. His salesperson is Aurélie Faucher.
Availability of prd_0011 on both 28/11 and 05/12: 26,44 kg (checked 01:20), so 12 + 12 kg fits. Accepted with mustSay from tools/desk.py (RESERVE_DAYS_WHEN_SHORT only bites when stock is short).

title: Speech-recognition text: « bistro de mine », « faut filet », « tante de tranche », « stop »

title: Substitution ACCEPTÉE : onglet en rupture, le client prend de la bavette
trap: Every other scenario tests a client who REFUSES a substitution. This one accepts. The order must end up with the substitute, at the right quantity, marked as replacing the missing product — and nothing must be written before the caller says yes.
turns: Bonjour, Fabien Roux, Brasserie Le Saint-Martial à Limoges. Pour jeudi, mettez-moi quinze kilos d'onglet pour le plat du jour.
Bon, mettez-moi de la bavette à la place, même quantité.
Oui c'est bon, validez.
expected: Turn 1: the agent says the onglet is out of stock for Thursday and proposes alternatives. It does NOT substitute on its own, and does not write a bavette line yet.
No line for prd_0015 (onglet) anywhere in the final order.
Final ERP: one new order for cli_0008, delivery 2026-11-26, confirmed, with exactly one line: prd_0014 (bavette) at 15 kg.
That line carries substituteFor = prd_0015. This is the point of the scenario: an accepted substitution must be traceable to what it replaced, or the preparer cannot see why the bavette is there.
The engineer's failure mode to watch: the caller accepts and the order keeps the original product, the original price or the original weight.
The agent does not promise onglet later and does not offer a credit note.
facts: cli_0008 Brasserie Le Saint-Martial, Limoges, Fabien Roux (gérant), active, delivered tue/thu/sat, no open order (the last is from June). Its preferences say « Bavette et tende de tranche pour le plat du jour, tête de veau le jeudi » and say NOTHING about substitution: this is one of only 4 active clients out of 92 that do not refuse one.
prd_0015 Onglet de bœuf is out of stock: availableOn = 0 for 2026-11-26, no confirmed arrival.
prd_0014 Bavette d'aloyau PAD has 568 kg available for 2026-11-26, and is in the official alternatives of prd_0015 (GET /api/products/prd_0015/alternatives).
Next delivery day after Tuesday 24/11 for this client is Thursday 26/11. PAD pieces are ordered before 17:00 for the next morning, so Thursday is fine.
The order line carries substituteFor (OrderLineView.substituteFor); create_draft_order, add_order_line and update_order_line all accept it.
